batch: ICAS 2021 Year 2 Mathematics（30 题全卷，中英双语）

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 数一数笑脸有几个

stem.en: How many smiley faces are there?
stem.zh: 图里一共有多少个笑脸？

solution.en: Point at each face and count: {n} in all.
solution.zh: 指着一个个数：一共 {n} 个。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 规律中缺了哪个图形

stem.en: The shapes repeat in a pattern. Which shape is missing from the box with the question mark?
stem.zh: 图形按规律重复出现。问号框里缺的是哪个图形？

solution.en: The four shapes repeat in this order: 1 square, 2 triangle, 3 circle, 4 star. The box with the question mark is number {mark} along the row. {mark} ÷ 4 leaves {pos}, so it is number {pos} inside its group of four — the same shape that sits in position {pos}. Compare with the boxes you can see to check.
solution.zh: 四个图形按「正方形、三角形、圆形、星形」的顺序不停重复，也就是第 1 个正方形、第 2 个三角形、第 3 个圆形、第 4 个星形。问号框是这一行里的第 {mark} 个；{mark} ÷ 4 余 {pos}，说明它在自己那一轮里排第 {pos}，缺的就是排在这个位置上的图形。可以对着前面几轮数一数验证。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: {d} 天后是星期几

stem.en: The picture shows the days of the week and marks today. What day will it be in {d} day(s)?
stem.zh: 图里是一周的七天，上面标着 Today（今天）的那一格就是今天。再过 {d} 天是星期几？

solution.en: Start at the marked day and step forward {d} day(s) along the strip. The order is Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and then it starts again — counting {d} steps from today gives the answer.
solution.zh: 从深色的「今天」开始，顺着图往后数 {d} 格。顺序是星期一、二、三、四、五、六、日，数完七天再从头开始。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两个人的划记相差几个

stem.en: The tally marks show how many goals Kate and Pete each scored. How many more goals did Kate score than Pete?
stem.zh: 划记表记录的是 Kate（凯特）和 Pete（彼得）各进了几个球。凯特比彼得多了几个？

solution.en: Read the tallies: Kate has {a}, Pete has {b}. One group of five is the fifth mark drawn across the other four. {a} - {b} = {d}.
solution.zh: 先读划记：每满五个是一组（第五笔横着划过去）。凯特 {a} 个，彼得 {b} 个，{a} − {b} = {d}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪两个图形完全一样

stem.en: Which two shapes are exactly the same shape and size?
stem.zh: 下面哪两个图形的大小和形状完全一样？

solution.en: Turning a shape around does not change it. One of the four is a square standing up and another is that same square turned 45°, so they are exactly the same. The tall diamond and the long rectangle are not squares, so they do not match anything.
solution.zh: 把图形转一下，形状和大小都没变。四格里有一格是正放的正方形，还有一格是它转 45° 的样子，这两个完全一样。又高又窄的菱形和细长的长方形都不是正方形，配不上。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪个数在两者之间

stem.en: Which number is between {lo} and {hi}?
stem.zh: 下面哪个数在 {lo} 和 {hi} 之间？

solution.en: {c} is bigger than {lo} and smaller than {hi}, so it is between them. {lo - 1} is too small; {hi + 1} and {hi + 5} are too big.
solution.zh: {c} 比 {lo} 大、比 {hi} 小，所以夹在中间。{lo - 1} 太小；{hi + 1} 和 {hi + 5} 太大了。

templates.noFigure: 题干和选项全是数字，题目本身不需要配图；原题也只是一组数字选项

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪些问题的答案是数

stem.en: Which TWO questions can be answered with a number? Choose two.
stem.zh: 下面哪「两个」问题的答案是一个数？（选两个）

options.en: How many pets do you have?

solution.en: "How many pets do you have?" is answered with a number of pets. "How old are you?" is answered with a number of years. A name and a yes/no answer are not numbers.
solution.zh: 「养了几只宠物」要用只数回答，「几岁了」要用岁数回答，这两个都是数。回答名字、回答「是/不是」都不是数。

templates.noFigure: 四个候选问题本身就是全部信息，配图无从画起、也不需要

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每次加同一个数的数列

stem.en: The numbers go up by {d} each time: {s}, {s + d}, {s + 2 * d}, {s + 3 * d}, ... What is the next number?
stem.zh: 下面每个数都比前一个多 {d}：{s}、{s + d}、{s + 2 * d}、{s + 3 * d}……下一个数是多少？

solution.en: Each step adds {d}. From {s + 3 * d} add {d} again: {s + 3 * d} + {d} = {s + 4 * d}.

templates.noFigure: 数列本身已经写在题干里，不需要配图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪张骨牌能和它配成一对

stem.en: Jim is matching dominoes by adding their spots together: two dominoes match when their spots add up to the SAME total. The figure shows a matching pair worked out for you. Which domino matches the one Jim picked up?
stem.zh: 吉姆把骨牌两半上的点数加起来配对：总数一样就算配成一对。图里已经给了一对做示范。哪张骨牌和吉姆拿起的这张配成一对？

solution.en: Add the two halves of every domino. Jim picked up {pa} + {pb} = {P}. So the matching domino must also add up to {P}: {ma} + {mb} = {P}. The other three add up to {g1a + g1b}, {g2a + g2b} and {g3a + g3b} — all different, so they cannot match.
solution.zh: 把每张骨牌两半的点数加起来。吉姆拿起的这张是 {pa} + {pb} = {P}。要和它配对，总数也得是 {P}：{ma} + {mb} = {P}。另外三张分别加起来是 {g1a + g1b}、{g2a + g2b}、{g3a + g3b}，都不一样，所以配不上。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 跟着箭头走，钥匙在哪盆花下面

stem.en: The key is hidden under one of the flower pots. Start at the house and follow the arrow, moving {n0} pot(s). Which colour pot is the key under?
stem.zh: 钥匙藏在其中一盆花的下面。从房子出发，按箭头指的方向走 {n0} 盆花，钥匙就压在你停下的那盆花下面。那盆花是什么颜色？（颜色名就写在每盆花的下方）

solution.en: Follow the arrow from the house and count the pots you pass — {n0} in all. The pot you stop at is the one with the key under it.
solution.zh: 从房子出发按箭头方向数花盆，一共走过 {n0} 盆。停下的那一盆下面就是钥匙，看图读出它的颜色。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 摆成阵列的蔬菜拿走一些

stem.en: The picture shows rows of vegetables. {t} of them are taken away. How many vegetables are left?
stem.zh: 图里的蔬菜排成整齐的几行。拿走 {t} 个以后，还剩多少个？

solution.en: The vegetables are in {r} rows of 6, so there are {6 * r} altogether. Take away {t}: {6 * r} - {t} = {6 * r - t}.
solution.zh: 蔬菜排成 {r} 行、每行 6 个，一共 {6 * r} 个。拿走 {t} 个：{6 * r} − {t} = {6 * r - t}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 把钟面和数字钟连起来

stem.en: Draw a line from each clock on the left to the digital clock on the right that shows the same time.
stem.zh: 把左边每个钟面和右边时间相同的电子钟连起来。

solution.en: On an analog clock the short hand shows the hour and the long hand shows the minutes. Read each clock, then join it to the digital clock with the same hours and minutes.
solution.zh: 模拟钟面上短针指小时，长针指分钟；长针指 12 是整点，指 6 是半点。照这样读出每个钟面的时刻，再连到右边数字相同的电子钟。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 箭头指着数轴上的哪个数（等分刻度）

stem.en: This number line goes from {B} to {E}, and the space in between is split into {n} equal intervals. Which number does the arrow point at?
stem.zh: 这条数轴从 {B} 到 {E}，中间平均分成了 {n} 格（每格一样大）。箭头指着的是哪个数？

solution.en: Do NOT count 1 per interval. First work out how much one interval is worth: {E} − {B} = {n * s}, shared equally between {n} intervals, so each interval is {n * s} ÷ {n} = {s}. The arrow sits on the {k}th interval: {B} + {k} × {s} = {ans}. (Counting 1 per mark would give {wrong1}, which is wrong.)
solution.zh: 不要一格数 1。先算出一格是多少：{E} − {B} = {n * s}，平均分成 {n} 格，每格 {n * s} ÷ {n} = {s}。箭头在第 {k} 格上，所以是 {B} + {k} × {s} = {ans}。（如果按「每格 1」去数会得到 {wrong1}，那是错的。）

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪一对图形不可能拿到

stem.en: One shape is taken from Box 1 and one shape from Box 2. Which pair of shapes could NOT be taken?
stem.zh: 从 Box 1（1 号盒子）里拿一个图形，再从 Box 2（2 号盒子）里拿一个图形。下面哪一对「不可能」拿到？

solution.en: Whatever you take, the first shape must come from Box 1 and the second from Box 2. Look for a pair whose second shape is not in Box 2 at all — that pair can never be taken. Any pair where the first shape is in Box 1 and the second is in Box 2 is possible.
solution.zh: 不管怎么拿，第一个图形必须来自 1 号盒子，第二个必须来自 2 号盒子。只要某一对里第二格那个图形根本不在 2 号盒子里，这一对就永远拿不到；其它几对两格都在相应的盒子里，都可能拿到。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 一排玩具车一共多长

stem.en: The picture shows {n} toy cars in a row. Each car is 5 cm long and the gap between two cars is 2 cm. How long is the whole row?
stem.zh: 图里 {n} 辆玩具车排成一行。每辆车长 5 厘米，车与车之间的间隔是 2 厘米。这一排从头到尾一共多长？

solution.en: The {n} cars take {n} × 5 = {5 * n} cm. Between {n} cars there are {n - 1} gaps, taking {n - 1} × 2 = {2 * (n - 1)} cm. Altogether {5 * n} + {2 * (n - 1)} = {5 * n + 2 * (n - 1)} cm.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 数一数用了几个小方块

stem.en: The solid is made of unit cubes. How many unit cubes are there altogether?
stem.zh: 这个立体图形是用同样大的小方块搭成的。一共用了多少个小方块？

solution.en: Count column by column. The front layer is {f0} + {f1} + {f2} + {f3} = {f0 + f1 + f2 + f3} cubes, and the back layer is {b0} + {b1} + {b2} + {b3} = {b0 + b1 + b2 + b3} cubes. Altogether {f0 + f1 + f2 + f3} + {b0 + b1 + b2 + b3} = {f0 + f1 + f2 + f3 + b0 + b1 + b2 + b3}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每组的泰迪每次多两只

stem.en: The number of bears goes up by two each time: Shape 1, then Shape 2. How many bears will be in Shape 3?
stem.zh: 每一组的泰迪都比前一组多 2 只：图上先画了 Shape 1（第 1 组），再画了 Shape 2（第 2 组）。第 3 组会有多少只泰迪？

solution.en: Count each group: Shape 1 has 2 rows of {c0} = {2 * c0} bears; Shape 2 has 2 rows of {c0 + 1} = {2 * (c0 + 1)} bears. That is 2 more each time, so Shape 3 has {2 * (c0 + 1)} + 2 = {2 * k1} bears — that is 2 rows of {k1}.
solution.zh: 先数每一组：第 1 组是 2 行、每行 {c0} 只，共 {2 * c0} 只；第 2 组是 2 行、每行 {c0 + 1} 只，共 {2 * (c0 + 1)} 只。每次多 2 只，所以第 3 组是 {2 * (c0 + 1)} + 2 = {2 * k1} 只，也就是 2 行、每行 {k1} 只。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪个图形的面积最小

stem.en: The three shapes are drawn on grid paper. Which shape has the smallest area?
stem.zh: 三个图形都画在方格纸上。哪个图形的面积最小？

solution.en: Count whole squares, and count two half-squares as one whole square. Yellow: {s0} squares + {t0} half-squares = {a0} half-squares; blue: {s1} + {t1} halves = {a1}; red: {s2} + {t2} halves = {a2}. The smallest is the one with the fewest half-squares.
solution.zh: 数整格，再把两个半格拼成一个整格。黄色：{s0} 个整格加 {t0} 个半格，合 {a0} 个半格；蓝色：{s1} 个整格加 {t1} 个半格，合 {a1} 个半格；红色：{s2} 个整格加 {t2} 个半格，合 {a2} 个半格。半格数最少的面积最小。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 先乘、再给出去、又买回来

stem.en: Mia has {r} boxes of pencils. Each box holds {b} pencils. She gives away {g} pencils and then buys {k} more. How many pencils does she have now?
stem.zh: 米娅有 {r} 盒铅笔，每盒 {b} 支。她送出 {g} 支，后来又买了 {k} 支。现在她一共有多少支铅笔？

solution.en: First find how many she starts with: {r} × {b} = {r * b}. Then give away {g}: {r * b} - {g} = {r * b - g}. Then add the {k} new ones: {r * b - g} + {k} = {r * b - g + k}.
solution.zh: 先算原来有多少支：{r} × {b} = {r * b} 支。送出 {g} 支：{r * b} − {g} = {r * b - g} 支。又买回 {k} 支：{r * b - g} + {k} = {r * b - g + k} 支。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪张柱状图画对了

stem.en: Tim, David and Amy picked some apples. David picked {dv} apples. Amy picked {kk} times as many apples as David. Tim picked {mm} more apples than Amy. Which graph shows the number of apples they each picked?
stem.zh: Tim（蒂姆）、David（戴维）和 Amy（艾米）摘苹果。David 摘了 {dv} 个；Amy 摘的个数是 David 的 {kk} 倍；Tim 比 Amy 多摘 {mm} 个。哪张柱状图表示的是他们三个人各摘了多少个？

solution.en: Work out the three numbers first — they are NOT written down for you. David picked {dv}. Amy picked {kk} times as many: {dv} × {kk} = {amy}. Tim picked {mm} more than Amy: {amy} + {mm} = {tim}. Only the graph whose bars read {tim}, {dv}, {amy} in the order Tim, David, Amy is right; each of the others has two of the children swapped.
solution.zh: 先把三个数算出来 —— 题目没有直接告诉你。David 摘了 {dv} 个；Amy 是它的 {kk} 倍：{dv} × {kk} = {amy} 个；Tim 比 Amy 多 {mm} 个：{amy} + {mm} = {tim} 个。只有 Tim、David、Amy 三根柱子依次是 {tim}、{dv}、{amy} 的那张图才是对的，其它几张都把两个人调换了。

templates.noFigure: 原题的四张柱状图就是四个选项本身（已逐张画在选项里），题干再画一张会和正确选项完全重复，等于把答案摆在眼前

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 哪瓶水正好装了一半

stem.en: Each bottle is the same size. Which one is half full?
stem.zh: 几个瓶子一样大。哪一瓶里的水正好是半瓶？

solution.en: Half of the bottle is the middle of it. The bottle is marked with {ridges} equal bands, so half way is at band {level}. The bottle whose water surface sits exactly on that middle band is half full; the others are too empty or too full.
solution.zh: 「一半」就是瓶子的一半高。瓶身上的小凹纹正好把它分成 {ridges} 格一样高的部分，所以半瓶的水面应该在第 {level} 格。水面正好停在这一格的才是半瓶，其它几瓶不是太少就是太多。

templates.noFigure: 原题的水瓶就是选项本身（四张水位不同的瓶子图已作为 optionsSvg 呈现），题干不需要再配一张主图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 按编号连线得到哪个图形

stem.en: Mia had this dot-to-dot picture: six dots, and every dot has a number on it. She joined the dots in the order of their numbers — 1 to 2, 2 to 3, and so on up to 6 — and then joined 6 back to 1. Which of these shows what Mia drew?
stem.zh: 米娅有一张连点图：6 个点，每个点上标着一个数字。她按数字的顺序把点连起来：1 连 2、2 连 3……一直连到 6，最后再从 6 连回 1。她画出来的是哪个图形？

solution.en: Find the dot numbered 1, then join the dots in order 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and finally from 6 back to 1. Only one of the four figures joins the dots in exactly that order. The others join them in a different order (going straight round the outside gives a hexagon; skipping every other dot gives a star). Check the figures one by one against the numbers.
solution.zh: 先找到标着 1 的那个点，再按 2、3、4、5、6 的顺序依次连过去，最后从 6 连回 1。四个图形里只有一个的连线顺序和编号完全一样；另外三个是按别的顺序连的（顺着外圈连会得到六边形，隔一个点连会得到五角星）。一幅一幅对着编号看。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三角形里缺的那个数

stem.en: The three numbers outside a triangle add up to the number written inside it. What number is missing from the last triangle?
stem.zh: 每个三角形外面三个数相加，正好等于写在三角形里面的那个数。最后一个三角形缺的是几？

solution.en: Check the rule on the first three triangles: for example 4 + 8 + 2 = 14, and 14 is written inside. So for the last one, the three outside numbers must add up to {v}. Two of them are {bl} and {br}, and {bl} + {br} = {bl + br}, so the missing number is {v} - {bl + br} = {v - bl - br}.
solution.zh: 先用前三个三角形验证规律：比如 4 + 8 + 2 = 14，里面写的就正好是 14。最后一个三角形外面的三个数相加应该等于 {v}。现在已经知道两个数 {bl} 和 {br}，{bl} + {br} = {bl + br}，所以缺的那个数是 {v} − {bl + br} = {v - bl - br}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两个人相差几岁

stem.en: Mum is {p} years old and Tom is {c} years old. What is the difference between their ages?
stem.zh: 妈妈 {p} 岁，汤姆 {c} 岁。两个人相差多少岁？

solution.en: "Difference" means how much more: {p} - {c} = {p - c}, so they are {p - c} years apart.
solution.zh: 「相差」就是多多少：{p} − {c} = {p - c}，两人相差 {p - c} 岁。

templates.noFigure: 纯文字应用题（比较两个人的年龄），年龄全在题干里，无图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 射中靶心一共得几分

stem.en: In this game a dart scores the number written in the ring where it lands. Ravi threw {k} darts and every dart landed in the ring worth the most points. He was then given {b} bonus points, but {m} points were taken off for a dart that fell on the floor. What was his score?
stem.zh: 在这个游戏里，飞镖落在哪个环里就得那个环上写的分数。拉维扔了 {k} 支飞镖，每一支都落在得分最高的那个环里；后来裁判又给他加了 {b} 分，不过因为有一支飞镖掉在地上，扣掉了 {m} 分。拉维最后得了多少分？

solution.en: Look at the target: the rings are numbered 1 to 5, and the number gets bigger towards the middle, so the centre ring is worth 5. {k} darts in the centre score {k} × 5 = {k * 5}. Add the {b} bonus points: {k * 5} + {b} = {k * 5 + b}. Take off {m}: {k * 5 + b} - {m} = {k * 5 + b - m}.
solution.zh: 先看靶盘：环上的数从外到内是 1 到 5，越靠中间越大，所以得分最高的中心环是 5 分。{k} 支都落在中心：{k} × 5 = {k * 5} 分。加上 {b} 分奖励：{k * 5} + {b} = {k * 5 + b}。再扣掉 {m} 分：{k * 5 + b} − {m} = {k * 5 + b - m} 分。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 停车场上共有多少辆车

stem.en: The picture graph shows the cars in a car park. One car picture stands for {ka} cars. How many cars are there altogether?
stem.zh: 象形统计图画的是停车场里的车。右边 KEY 框里写着：每个小汽车代表 {ka} 辆真车。停车场上共有多少辆车？

solution.en: Count the car pictures: {a} + {b} + {c} = {a + b + c} pictures. Each picture stands for {ka} cars (the KEY box tells you), so {a + b + c} × {ka} = {(a + b + c) * ka} cars.
solution.zh: 先数图上小汽车的个数：{a} + {b} + {c} = {a + b + c} 个。再看右边的 KEY：每个小汽车代表 {ka} 辆真车。所以一共 {a + b + c} × {ka} = {(a + b + c) * ka} 辆。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 只和三个六边形相接的有几块

stem.en: These hexagons fit together like tiles, and every hexagon is painted the same colour. How many hexagons are touching ONLY three other hexagons?
stem.zh: 这些六边形像瓷砖一样拼在一起，每一块颜色都一样。有几个六边形只和 3 个其它六边形相接（不是 4 个、也不是 6 个）？

solution.en: Count, for each hexagon in the picture, how many other hexagons it shares an edge with (a hexagon can share at most six). Do not skip the ones along the outside edge — a hexagon in a corner touches fewer than the ones buried in the middle. The number touching only three others is {cnt}.
solution.zh: 对着图一块一块地数：数它和几个其它六边形共用一条边（最多 6 个）。别漏掉外圈那些 —— 挤在中间的接得多，边角上的接得少。只和 3 个相接的一共 {cnt} 块。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 飞走一些又回来一些

stem.en: There were {a} birds in a tree. {b} of them flew away and then {c} birds came back. How many birds are in the tree now?
stem.zh: 树上原来有 {a} 只鸟，飞走了 {b} 只，后来又飞回来 {c} 只。现在树上有多少只鸟？

solution.en: Write it as one number sentence: {a} - {b} + {c}. Work from the left: {a} - {b} = {a - b}, then {a - b} + {c} = {a - b + c}.
solution.zh: 把它写成一个算式：{a} − {b} + {c}。从左往右算：{a} − {b} = {a - b}，再 {a - b} + {c} = {a - b + c}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 按距离条件推出四栋房子各住谁

stem.en: Pete, Sita, Lin and Ben are friends. They live in these four houses (look at how far apart the houses are, and where the tree is). {X} and {Y} each live {U1} paces from {Z}. {Z} and {Y} each live {U2} paces from {W}. Which list gives the four children in the order of the houses from LEFT to RIGHT?
stem.zh: Pete（皮特）、Sita（西塔）、Lin（林）和 Ben（本）住在这四栋房子里（注意房子之间的距离，还有大树的位置）。{X} 和 {Y} 离 {Z} 都是 {U1} 步；{Z} 和 {Y} 离 {W} 都是 {U2} 步。从左到右，这四栋房子里依次住的是谁？

solution.en: The houses are NOT equally spaced — the widest gap is where the tree stands, so the figure tells you which end of the row has the big space. {X} and {Y} are each {U1} paces from {Z}, so they must be the two houses that are {U1} apart from {Z} (one on each side of the row). {Y} is also {U2} paces from {W}, so {W} has to be the house next to {Y}. Putting those together leaves only one arrangement: {a1}, {a2}, {a3}, {a4}.
solution.zh: 四栋房子之间的距离并不一样 —— 大树站在最宽的那段空隙里，所以看图就能知道「宽的那段在哪一头」。{X} 和 {Y} 离 {Z} 都是 {U1} 步，说明它们就是离 {Z} 有 {U1} 步的那两栋（一左一右）。{Y} 离 {W} 又是 {U2} 步，所以 {W} 只能紧挨着 {Y}。合起来只剩一种排法：{a1}、{a2}、{a3}、{a4}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每天比前一天多取，第几天取空

stem.en: Pirate Pete had {T} gold pieces in his treasure chest. On the first day he took out {a} gold pieces. Each day after that he took out {d} MORE gold pieces than he had taken out the day before. The table shows the first 3 days. On which day did Pirate Pete empty the treasure chest?
stem.zh: 海盗皮特的宝箱里原有 {T} 枚金币。第一天他取出 {a} 枚；以后每天取出的枚数都比前一天多 {d} 枚。表格给出的是前三天。第几天他会把宝箱取空？

solution.en: The amounts taken out are {a}, {a + d}, {a + 2 * d}, … — the same number ({d}) MORE every day, so it is an arithmetic pattern, not a fixed amount per day. Keep adding a day at a time until the total reaches {T}: it lands on exactly {T} on day {n}, so the chest is empty after day {n}.
solution.zh: 每天取出的枚数是 {a}、{a + d}、{a + 2 * d}……每天多 {d} 枚，是等差数列（不是每天都取一样多）。一天一天往下加，加到第 {n} 天正好是 {T} 枚，所以第 {n} 天取空。

cols: Number of gold pieces taken out
